# Always-On Experience Injection

###### Abstract
We inject experience summaries.

## 4 Results
Injecting a persistent experience summary into every prompt improved solve rate on short tasks but degraded it on long tasks. In this paragraph we describe injection in detail, covering the setup, the datasets, the metrics and the controls used for every comparison.
